name: Edara Connect
author: EDRAK Software

sections.description:
Edara Connect integrates your WooCommerce store with Edara ERP, a powerful cloud-based solution for managing finances, sales, inventory, and operations. Whether you run an e-commerce business, retail store, or distribution network, this plugin streamlines your workflows by connecting all business operations into a single platform.

Features

  1. Seamless Order Sync from WooCommerce to edara for streamlined processing.
  2. Effortless Customer Sync from WooCommerce to edara for unified data management.
  3. Automatic Inventory Balance Sync ensures accurate product quantities across platforms.
  4. Real-time Price and Product Data Updates for consistent information.
sections.changelog:
2025-08-31 – version 1.2.2

  • Dynamic properties are now mapped with woocommerce global attributes.
  • Fix orders discounts being double applied on updates from edara.

2025-08-21 – version 1.2.2

  • Fix wrong customer issue

2025-07-06 – version 1.2.0

  • Added incoming order updates from Edara to WooCommerce
  • Added WooCommerce Order Number to paper number in Edara
  • Added option to choose either Edara price or dealer price for WooCommerce regular price with discounts

2025-06-19 – version 1.1.1

  • Added WooCommerce order cancellation sync with Edara ERP.

2025-06-16 – version 1.1.0

  • Added advanced product sync direction and robust product linking
  • Improved variable product and WPML compatibility (main product only for price/stock)
  • Enhanced settings UI/UX and product table display
  • Fixed duplicate product linking and empty SKU handling
  • General bug fixes and performance improvements

2025-06-12 – version 1.0.4

  • Improved performance by optimizing cache handling
  • Fixed API token persistence issues
  • Enhanced API communication reliability

2025-05-07 – version 1.0.3

  • Bug fixes

2025-03-04 – version 1.0.2

  • Bug fixes & base improvements

2025-03-04 – version 1.0.1

  • Bug fixes

2025-01-27 – version 1.0.0

  • First public release
